issues.spec_citation: FHIRPath Normative Release §5.5.1 iif and §4.5 singleton evaluation
issues.evidence: Fresh FP-06 HISTORIAN probe found native C++ accepts malformed iif calls. `fhirpath_is_valid('iif(true)')` returned true, `fhirpath_json('{}', "iif(true, 'yes', 'no', 'extra')")` returned `["yes"]`, and `fhirpath_is_valid("iif(1|2, 'yes', 'no')")` returned true. Forced Python fallback returned empty/NULL with `fhirpath_is_valid=false`. Spec signature is `iif(criterion, true-result [, otherwise-result])`, and multi-item singleton Boolean evaluation must signal an error.
issues.root_cause: Native evaluator dispatch accepted any iif() call with at least two children and returned empty for one-argument/multi-item-criterion paths instead of throwing a spec error, so fhirpath_is_valid treated malformed iif expressions as valid.
issues.resolution: Added exact native iif arity validation, changed native iif multi-item input/criterion handling to throw FHIRPathSpecError, and added native/Python parity plus sqllogictest coverage for malformed iif arity, multi-item criterion, and lazy unselected branches.

issues.spec_citation: FHIRPath Normative Release §5.5.2 Boolean Conversion and §5.5.3 Integer Conversion
issues.evidence: Fresh FP-06 HISTORIAN probe found native C++ ignores extra args for zero-argument `toBoolean()`/`toInteger()` calls: `true.toBoolean(1)` returned true and `'1'.toInteger(2)` returned 1 with `fhirpath_is_valid=true`. The same probe found forced Python fallback returned `fhirpath_is_valid=true` for constant multi-item inputs like `(true|false).toBoolean()`, `(1|2).toInteger()`, and `(1|2).convertsToInteger()` instead of treating the spec-required multi-item converter error as invalid.
issues.root_cause: Native toBoolean()/toInteger() dispatch did not enforce the zero-argument signatures and ignored extra children. Python fallback toInteger()/toBoolean()/generic convertsTo helpers returned empty for multi-item input instead of signaling the spec-required multi-item conversion error, leaving fhirpath_is_valid parity gaps.
issues.resolution: Added native exact arity checks for toBoolean()/toInteger(), changed Python fallback Boolean/Integer conversion helpers and generic convertsTo helper to raise on multi-item input while preserving empty propagation, and added regression coverage for wrong arity and constant multi-item converter inputs.
